question: Every coupled cell of every census in this corpus is graded on C-0058's equal springs and its rim-graded 5:1, both of them rules TRANSFERRED onto the lattice rather than optima OF it. Does a distribution SEARCHED at C-0208's resolved per-bond link close the 0.198 % its tightest cell misses T-5b by?
maturity: TRL 1-3. Model-consistent and traceable. NOT empirically demonstrated. Every number here is a property of one lattice, one placement family, one raster, one load case and one dropout model, and the radial constant it is read at is a bracket of constructions with one measured term in it (C-0208).

units.dishing: dimensionless, as a fraction of the free stroke
units.ratio: dimensionless, max over min of a per-path stiffness vector

conventions.s: along the helices, origin at the face centre
conventions.y: across the helices in the plane of the face, origin at the face centre
conventions.dishing: the peak of |w - the best-fit rigid plane| over an 81 x 81 face grid, divided by the free-tile stroke
conventions.resolvedLink: k_radial * unitZ^2 + k_transverse * unitY^2 per bond (C-0208), with k_transverse pinned at C-0205's ceiling
conventions.transferred: a distribution RULE evaluated on the station set -- C-0058's equal springs and its rim-graded 5:1 at a 6.7 nm band
conventions.searched: the composition of C-0135's smoothed minimax on the zero-defect peak and a multi-start coordinate descent on the TRUE training percentile, every decision rounded at six significant digits
conventions.outOfSample: graded on the 197197 stream, which the search never sees; the search sees the 316316 stream
conventions.ratio: max/min over the per-path stiffnesses, the axis C-0060 measures a buildable window on

parameters.mandate: C-0017's 33.3333333 pN/nm on the SUM, section 3's acceptable clause

sources: gpd/results/T-3b-tile-edge-load-profile.json (C-0022's solved collar at 2 mM / 10 nm / 0.192 V)
gpd/results/T-310-a-bond-link-is-two-mechanisms.json (C-0208's own coupled cells at the resolved link, read and reproduced at every graded cell)

cheapBound.question: how far apart are C-0058's TWO transferred distributions at C-0208's tightest cell, before anything is searched
cheapBound.answer: the equal-spring reading is 0.123631078 and the rim-graded one 0.100198485 of the free stroke, both read out of C-0208's own committed result file
cheapBound.units: dimensionless, a ratio of two 90th percentiles
cheapBound.consequence: the one-dimensional family the corpus has always graded on is not flat, and the 23.4 % between its own two members is larger than the 0.198 % the tightest cell misses T-5b by. That is a COST bound and not an exclusion: it says the search is worth running, and it is one division on a committed file.

cheapBound.question: what does one influence bank cost, and how many distributions does it serve
cheapBound.answer: an InfluenceSurrogate is a property of the STRUCTURE -- the lattice, the station set and the load -- and a distribution enters the Woodbury system as a DIAGONAL, so one bank per (placement, columns, fraction, rung) serves every distribution ever tried at that cell at one n x n Cholesky each
cheapBound.units: point-load lattice solves per (fraction, rung) and per placement
cheapBound.consequence: the search costs no new factorisation of the 4 080-degree-of-freedom lattice, which is what makes this a study rather than a proposal

findings: A distribution SEARCHED at the resolved per-bond link reads 0.0647024141 at its tightest cell against the transferred 0.100198485 -- a gain of 54.9 % on the deciding statistic -- and 22 of 32 cells are flat at the 90th percentile.

The search is worth its cost IN SAMPLE at 32 of 32 cells by construction and OUT OF SAMPLE at 32 of 32. The gap between the two is what a percentile optimised on a finite training stream costs, and it is emitted per cell rather than argued.

The oracle p90 floor -- a rigorous lower bound over every force vector and therefore over every distribution whatever -- excludes 0 of 32 cells before any search runs, and the best transferred distribution sits 76.9529259 to 209.690778 times above it. CLAUDE.md's statement that such a floor can exclude and can never admit is reproduced here on a second lattice.

The ratio the argmin demands is a threshold the flatness falsifier cannot see. At the tightest searched cell it is 191.010656 against C-0060's measured buildable [3.5, 20.0], OUTSIDE it -- and quantised onto C-0060's own two levels the same distribution reads 0.118704593.

The verdict is a property of the question and not of one radial rung: over C-0208's five rungs the searched tightest cell reads 0.0699392016; 0.066782473; 0.0647024141; 0.0606641028; 0.0705668742, and the flat count moves not at all.
validity: The search is over the STIFFNESS vector alone. The placement, the cross-section, the raster, the load case, the link resolution and the radial bracket are all C-0208's and none of them moves here.

C-0017's mandate is an EQUALITY ON THE SUM, so every distribution graded here spends the same total. A search that were allowed to spend more would not be answering this question, and CLAUDE.md records that a mandate on a sum is not a mandate on each term.

The percentile is an ORDER STATISTIC, so C-0135's log-sum-exp smoothing and its adjoint gradient do NOT transfer to it. They are applied here to the zero-defect peak, which IS a max of smooth functions, and the percentile is searched by a multi-start coordinate descent with every decision rounded at six significant digits. A smoothed CVaR of a smoothed peak would be differentiable throughout and is named as an open question, not attempted.

A descent reports the best point it FOUND. The sweep budget is emitted as a convergence axis so a reader can see how much the search still had left, and the oracle floor is emitted beside every cell as the honest statement of how much room any distribution could still have.

The training ensemble is 120 realisations of seed 316316 and the grading one 4000 of seed 197197. Every percentile in the census is read on the grading stream and is therefore out of sample; the training reading is emitted beside it and is in sample by construction.

The census is taken on ROUTE A, whose raster turns carry ZERO unpaired nucleotides (C-0175's modelling choice). C-0193 and C-0200 establish that the only folded block of this cross-section does otherwise, so the whole census is a statement about a design nobody has folded.
The transverse constant is pinned at C-0205's ceiling throughout, which is its generous reading, and C-0208 records that the measured pair term would lower it.
